# `kernel/arch/i386/i386` — i386 machine-dependent core (locore, pmap, trap, cons)

## English

This directory contains i386 machine-dependent core (locore, pmap, trap, cons).

`config.mk` records 16 source file(s) here: `autoconf.c`, `conf.c`, `cons.c`, `dkbad.c`, `genassym.c`, `in_cksum.c`, `kgdb_glue.c`, `kgdb_stub.c`, `locore.s`, `machdep.c`, `mem.c`, `pmap.c`, ....

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文

本目录包含i386 机器相关核心（locore、pmap、trap、cons）。
